routes.summary: Kommently lets teams and clients pin comments on live websites, PDFs, and images, with a screenshot, page, and device size on every comment, and integrations for Slack, Jira, Discord, and Teams.

faq.question: How does Kommently work?
faq.answer: Paste a website link or upload PDFs and images. Switch to Comment, click anywhere, and write your note. Each comment is pinned to that spot, with the page URL, device size, and a screenshot, and opens a thread for the discussion.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything on my website?
faq.answer: No. There is no script to add and no browser extension. Kommently loads the page for you, including staging sites and pages behind a login, and you review it in the browser.

faq.question: What if a website can’t be loaded?
faq.answer: A few sites use firewall protection that blocks review tools. Kommently tells you when that happens, and you can still collect feedback by uploading screenshots or a PDF of the pages to a document project.

faq.question: Do clients need an account to review?
faq.answer: No. Share a review link and clients can view the site and pin their own comments with just a name and email. You can protect links with a password and an expiry date, make them view-only, or turn them off at any time.

faq.question: Can I keep each client separate?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a workspace per client and keep their sites and documents in it. Invite people to the whole workspace, give each person Can manage, Can comment or Can view, and share one review link that lists every project in it. One plan covers all your workspaces.

faq.question: Which tools does Kommently connect to?
faq.answer: Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Discord get notifications for new pins, comments, and status changes. Jira gets a new issue for every new pin. Integrations are included from the Starter plan and can be set for the whole workspace or per project.

faq.question: How is our data handled?
faq.answer: Everything is sent over HTTPS, access is limited to your workspace members and the guests you invite, and you can export your data or delete your workspace from settings at any time. Payments are processed by Razorpay or PayPal; we never see card details.

faq.question: Can I try Kommently for free before paying?
faq.answer: Yes. Every new workspace starts with a 30-day free trial with all Pro features, and no credit card is required. We email you before the trial ends so you can choose a plan.

faq.question: Do client reviewers count as members?
faq.answer: No. Guests have their own allowance (2 on Free, 10 on Starter, 50 on Pro) and review through a share link without joining your workspace.

faq.question: What happens if we outgrow our plan?
faq.answer: Upgrade any time from Settings → Billing when you need more projects, guests, or storage. Enterprise covers custom limits, terms, and onboarding.

faq.question: Can we cancel monthly plans?
faq.answer: Yes. Cancel any time from Settings → Billing. You keep your plan until the end of the period you already paid for, and you are not charged again.
